gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Loud, loose and a bit cheeky. Revalia stretches its widely spaced letters across the line, while Noto Sans Kaithi, a plain sans, fills its lowercase to near-capital height and stays out of the way.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada is friendly and gently stepped, rising softly from small letters to capitals. Revalia sits above it with a bold display swagger, and the two share a page without crowding each other.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Revalia lays down a tall band of bold, expressive letters with short stalks above and a g that leaves its lower curve open. Noto Sans Kayah Li, a clean sans-serif, then carries a page easily.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: That open-tailed g and the relaxed, widely spaced stride mark Revalia as a display face with real attitude. Noto Sans Kharoshthi follows in a dark, approachable stripe, comfortable page after page.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Big, stretched out and unbothered, Revalia spaces its bold letters widely, while Noto Sans Khmer, a plain sans, answers with generous notch-like openings and lowercase standing nearly as tall as capitals. They feel like a loud friend and a steady one.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Bold, loose and full of nerve. Revalia heads the page with its open-curved g and wide stride, and Noto Sans Khojki underneath lets light through its wide exits and big-eyed e shapes.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, with rounds left unlatched like an open hook. Beside it, Revalia's bold, widely spaced display letters get plenty of room to be the loud one.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kr: Revalia is all bold, expressive display, with a tall letter band and an open-bottomed g. Noto Sans KR, a sans-serif with a big x-height and stubby ascenders, settles in beneath it and lets the heading talk.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lao: A g with its lower curve left open gives Revalia a relaxed, bold swagger across widely spaced letters. Noto Sans Lao, a plain sans with a tall x-height, keeps its mouths open and makes long reading feel effortless.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Expressive and loose, Revalia strides across the page in bold letters with short stalks above its tall band. Noto Sans Lao Looped, a sans-serif, forms words into solid blocks, so a long passage reads smoothly.
